transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?
I’m just… really tired. Like, I can barely get through a shift lately. Resting doesn’t seem to fix it. My body feels kind of heavy, like wet sand.
Have you been feeling down or depressed?
I don’t know… maybe a little. I’ve just been worn out, mostly. I haven’t really wanted to think about whether it’s “depressed” or not.
Have you lost interest in things you usually enjoy?
Yeah… I guess so. Stuff I usually like—cooking, playing guitar, hiking, even going to my family’s—it all just feels kind of flat. Like I’m doing it because I’m supposed to, not because I care.
Have you been feeling sad or down most days?
I’m not really sure. Some days I feel kind of low, I guess, but mostly I just feel drained.
For the past couple of weeks, have you felt down or depressed most of the day nearly every day?
I’m not sure I’d say nearly every day… I’ve felt off and kind of low, but I don’t really know if it’s been most of the day.
Did something stressful happen in your life around the time this started?
Yeah… around when the store started the remodel. They changed all our hours, and since then—maybe about a month now—it’s kind of been going on.
If the work schedule changes were resolved, do you think you’d start feeling like yourself again?
I don’t know… maybe. If things went back to normal at work, I think that would help, but I’m not sure it would fix everything.
Have you been having trouble concentrating?

Yeah… a bit. At work especially, when I’m ringing people up, every beep from the scanner or noise from the remodel, or someone walking by, kind of pulls me off track. Then I forget where I was for a second.
During the past two weeks, have you felt sad or down most of the day nearly every day?
I mean… not most of the day every day, no. I’ve felt off, but I wouldn’t say sad like that.
Have you been feeling nervous or anxious a lot lately?
I’m not sure… I mean, I get tense sometimes, but I wouldn’t say it’s all the time or anything.
Have you been having trouble sleeping?

Yeah… sleep’s been kind of messed up. With the shifts changing, I got used to only sleeping a few hours and still feeling wired. Now even when I’m really tired, I wake up early and my mind’s already going.
Have you been feeling worthless or guilty lately?
Yeah… some. I keep feeling like I’ve let people down. Like my manager, my family… even my nieces. And I keep going over little mistakes at the register like it means I’m just… not good enough.
Have you had any times lately when you felt unusually energized or up, like you needed much less sleep and still felt full of energy?

Yeah… there was a stretch where I felt really up, like I could handle anything. Almost too cheerful, I guess. But then little stuff would set me off, like being asked to count my drawer again. I’d get way more irritated than I should’ve.
About how many days did that unusually energized stretch last?
I guess… about a month? Since the store changed our hours for the remodel.
During that month when you felt unusually up, were you more active than usual or taking on more projects than you normally would?

Yeah… I guess I was. I kept volunteering for extra cash-office stuff, and I started reorganizing shelves. I even made this whole binder for promotions… and then I’d go home still wanting to shop online and move furniture around.
During that time, did you feel unusually confident or powerful, like you could do things other people couldn’t?
I don’t know… not really powerful. I felt more sure of myself than usual, I guess, but I wouldn’t say I could do things other people couldn’t.
During that time, were you doing things that were unusually risky or impulsive for you?
I’m not sure… I mean, I don’t think so. Maybe I bought more stuff than usual, but I wouldn’t call it risky.
During that month when you felt unusually up and needed less sleep, did it cause serious problems in your life or at work?

Yeah… it did. At work I started making mistakes on the register and falling behind with the cash-office stuff. My manager took me off some things I’d been hoping would help me move up.

And… I wasn’t really dealing with family much. I kind of avoided them. It got bad enough that I needed same-day crisis help because I didn’t feel safe handling it by myself.
During that time when you felt unusually up, did you have any hallucinations or delusions?
Yeah… I guess. At work, at the register, I’d hear people whispering my name, or saying I was messing everything up. But when I looked, there wasn’t anyone there.

final_diagnosis.reason: The interview supports a bipolar affective disorder current episode manic with psychotic symptoms: the patient describes about a month of abnormally elevated/energized mood with decreased need for sleep, increased activity, irritability, and increased goal-directed behavior, causing marked occupational and interpersonal impairment and requiring same-day crisis help. Psychotic symptoms were confirmed by hearing whispers/voices saying the patient was messing up when no one was there. Bipolar disorder unspecified remained a differential only because some depressive features were present but not sufficient for a clearly defined major depressive episode.
